title: The Class Action Fairness Act
summary: CAFA creates special federal jurisdiction and removal rules for qualifying class and mass actions. The assigned overview describes an aggregate amount requirement, specified diversity, size conditions, and exceptions.
notes: The casebook overview is available, and the statutory text (28 U.S.C. § 1332(d), PDF page 147; § 1453, PDF page 158) is in the supplement on file, linked below. Standard Fire addresses pre-certification stipulations and Dart Cherokee addresses allegations and proof of the amount; neither eliminates the remaining statutory requirements.

sections.Meaning: CAFA creates special federal jurisdiction and removal rules for qualifying class and mass actions. The assigned overview describes an aggregate amount requirement, specified diversity, size conditions, and exceptions.
sections.How to work through the question: Identify the proposed class, aggregate amount, citizenship relationships, number of members, and any local-controversy, home-state, or other exclusion. Then examine the special removal provisions rather than automatically applying all ordinary diversity-removal limitations.
